title: Nimble Peruvian Chicken Broth
description: A malty, aerated broth with grape juice and deglaze fond, featuring tender chicken and aromatic vegetables for a comforting Peruvian flavor.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add whole chicken thighs and brown on all sides until golden, about 8 minutes.
Remove thighs and set aside; deglaze pot with grape juice, scraping up browned bits.
Add onion, carrot, celery, paprika, salt, pepper, and bay leaf; sauté until vegetables soften, about 5 minutes.
Return chicken to pot, pour in water, and bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and cook for 45 minutes, or until chicken is tender and easily shredded.
Remove chicken, shred with two forks, and return meat to the broth.
Stir in deglaze fond (butter or pan drippings) until melted and incorporated.
Taste and adjust seasoning; serve hot over quinoa or rice if desired.
